name: Claude Dupont
source:
A magnetic lizard descendant, and Lars's potential love interest. With a prestigious family lineage, Claude is renowned as a daring merchant. 

As Lars' frequent partner in guild expeditions, he finds great delight in having Lars by his side all while making playful jabs at every turn. A true go-getter, Claude cruises through life with a bold spirit, seeking opportunities to quench his thirst for ambition.

[From [url=https://deniz-g-lerosi.itch.io/love-amidst-the-timeless-rift]official profile[/url]]
